description.value: Thai Son is a multi-location Vietnamese restaurant serving authentic phở, hủ tiếu, and other traditional noodle dishes in Richmond. The menu centres on a wide variety of beef noodle soups and special pork-and-seafood noodle combinations, prepared with classic Vietnamese accompaniments. Both dine-in and takeout are available, offering touring cyclists a warm, filling meal option.
